name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1877: The carved scar says the last CSS declaration wins and that editing the first occurrence looks like the edit did not take. Measured on the board: 4682 top-level rules, 201 selectors declared more than once, 153 setting the same property in more than one block. That is deliberate in a file grown over 1800 versions, so it is a lookup rather than a gate - a gate would cry wolf 153 times and be turned off. The tool answers which block wins for a selector and a property, and it had to be made exact first: the first cut reported two different rules at the same line, which in a tool whose whole job is which copy do I edit is worse than printing nothing.
